queries.title: Daily delivered, reconciled revenue by zone and store (separate grains).
queries.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN grouping(store_id)=1 THEN 'ZONE' ELSE 'STORE' END grain,order_date,zone,store_id,store_name,count(*) orders,sum(net_revenue) net_revenue
FROM etl_fact_orders JOIN etl_dim_store USING(store_id) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((order_date,zone),(order_date,zone,store_id,store_name)) ORDER BY ALL;

queries.title: Category revenue and gross margin.
queries.sql: SELECT category,count(*) orders,sum(net_revenue) net_revenue,sum(gross_margin) gross_margin FROM etl_fact_orders JOIN etl_dim_product USING(product_id) GROUP BY category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;

queries.title: All operationally valid delivered orders, independent of payment collection.
Finance revenue and every reconciliation exception, including rejected/orphan records.
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT payment_mode,sum(net_revenue) revenue FROM etl_fact_orders GROUP BY payment_mode),
m AS (SELECT coalesce(payment_mode,'UNKNOWN') payment_mode,sum(abs(amount_difference)) mismatch,count(*) mismatch_orders FROM etl_payment_reconciliation GROUP BY 1),
x AS (SELECT coalesce(r.payment_mode,m.payment_mode) payment_mode,coalesce(revenue,0) revenue,coalesce(mismatch,0) mismatch,coalesce(mismatch_orders,0) mismatch_orders FROM r FULL JOIN m USING(payment_mode))
SELECT coalesce(payment_mode,'ALL') payment_mode,sum(revenue) net_revenue,sum(mismatch) absolute_unreconciled_amount,sum(mismatch_orders) mismatch_orders FROM x GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((payment_mode),()) ORDER BY payment_mode;

queries.title: Top ten customers by reconciled spend, with loyalty tier and no contacts.
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id,loyalty_tier,count(*) orders,sum(net_revenue) total_spend FROM etl_fact_orders JOIN etl_dim_customer USING(customer_id) GROUP BY customer_id,loyalty_tier ORDER BY total_spend DESC,customer_id LIMIT 10;

queries.title: Rejection occurrences across all runs today in IST, grouped by source and reason.
queries.sql: SELECT source_file,failure_reason,count(*) rejected_rows FROM etl_rejected_rows WHERE cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata',checked_at) AS DATE)=cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata',current_timestamp) AS DATE) GROUP BY source_file,failure_reason ORDER BY ALL;

dq_results.sql: SELECT * FROM dq_results WHERE run_id=? ORDER BY dimension,check_name

pipeline_runs.sql: SELECT * FROM pipeline_runs ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 3

etl_payment_reconciliation.sql: SELECT order_id,order_amount,amount_paid,reason FROM etl_payment_reconciliation ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 12
